question: Rural Backyard Piggery Scheme was launched by which state government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rural Backyard Piggery Scheme** is a government initiative to promote **pig farming **in rural areas.
 
• This scheme aims to provide** livelihood opportunities** to rural households and** increase their income.**
 
• **Meghalaya** is known for its pig farming culture and has a huge demand for **pork** in the market.
 
• The government of Meghalaya launched this scheme to provide** financial assistance** to rural households to set up piggeries and improve their pig farming practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam: **

 
 
• Assam has also launched a scheme called** "Assam Pig Development Scheme" **to promote pig farming in the state.
 
• This scheme aims to provide** financial assistance** to pig farmers for setting up piggeries, purchase of piglets, and other inputs.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand:**
 
 
• Jharkhand has launched a scheme called **"Mukhya Mantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana"** to provide financial assistance to farmers for various agricultural activities, including pig farming.
 
• Under this scheme, farmers can avail of** subsidies** for setting up piggeries and purchasing piglets.
 
 
 
• **Punjab:**
 
 
• Punjab has launched a scheme called **"Punjab Piggery Development Scheme" **to promote pig farming in the state.
 
• This scheme aims to provide** financial assistance** to pig farmers for setting up piggeries, purchase of piglets, and other inputs.
